annotations.text: homepage-v1 — the founder-approved homepage and identity, 2026-09-08. Not a wireframe: this is the finished direction every other artboard is drawn in. Round 2 changed copy and section order only.

system — v2 (2026-10-03): the letter-home tokens, type ramp and components; the sheet leads src/modules/ui until the v2 implementation lands. the shipped design system: every primitive at every state, the type ramp and script coverage, the palette and its contrast manifest. Kept in step with src/modules/ui in both directions.

flows — the buyer journey home → track, the florist journey landing → first order, and the first-visit surfaces. Round 2: destination and date are settled before the basket, and the total cannot move after the product page.

v2 (2026-10-03, founder-locked): redrawn in the letter-home look — home, the country shop root, country category, country occasion, the two hubs, the occasions index, the destinations hub, the country guide, the product page, not-found and the chrome. The rest (locale chooser, checkout, confirmation, track, for florists, legal, how it works, guarantee, about, blog) are still drawn in v1 and are redrawn by the task that next builds them. wireframes — one desktop (1440) and one mobile (390) artboard per Phase 0 page type, in buyer-journey order. Round 2 (TASK-059, 2026-09-09): every page reworked against docs/design/benchmarks/. Spec 008 added the six listing and hub artboards; spec 009's round rebuilds product-desktop and product-mobile around the three date-picker states — unavailable, preview and live — and takes the countdown, the relative “today” chip, the Continue button, the add-on checkboxes, the withdrawal notice and the photo-on-delivery promise out of them. benchmarks/README.md records what each page type took and dropped, and the questions left for the founder.

Home · v2 (the letter home) — desktop 1440 and mobile 390. Direction A's layout in direction C's colours, locked by the founder 2026-10-03. Supersedes homepage-v1/homepage-{desktop,mobile}, which stay as the 2026-09-08 record.
